Scenario: Submit a complete application with a PDF resume
Steps: Fill every required field, attach test-qa-resume.pdf, tick consent, Submit Application
Expected result: "Application received" with a reference ID; application stored with status new
Actual result: Application received with reference ID; stored with status new and resume

Scenario: Submit the empty form
Steps: Click Submit Application

Scenario: Resume with a disallowed file type is rejected
Steps: Attach test-qa-notes.txt, submit
Expected result: "Resume must be PDF, DOC, or DOCX." and nothing stored

Scenario: Typed values survive a server-side rejection
Steps: Submit, read the fields after the error appears
Expected result: All typed values and the attached file are still in the form
Actual result: Initially every field was wiped (DEF-004). After the fix the values and file are kept

Scenario: Inactive job does not accept applications
Preconditions: [TEST] QA Job closed published with active = false
Steps: Open the job page; then post the apply action with this job's ID
Expected result: Page shows "no longer accepting applications"; action rejects, nothing stored; job hidden from /careers
Actual result: Form hidden with the closed message; action rejected; nothing stored; not listed

Scenario: Job past its application deadline does not accept applications
Preconditions: [TEST] QA Job expired published, active, deadline 2026-01-15
Steps: Open /careers and the job page; then post the apply action with this job's ID
Expected result: Not listed, page shows closed message, action rejects
Actual result: Initially listed and accepting applications (DEF-005). After the fix: not listed, closed message, action rejected

Scenario: Too-short message is rejected and typed values are kept
Steps: Fill name, email, company, job title, country, phone; message "short"; Submit
Expected result: "Please provide a brief message", fields keep their values, nothing stored
Actual result: Field error shown, values kept, nothing stored

Scenario: Valid enquiry creates a lead and clears the form
Steps: Fill all fields with a TEST-QA message, Submit
Expected result: Thank-you message, form cleared, lead stored with status new, notify email sent
Actual result: Thank-you message, form cleared, lead stored (intent business, status new), SMTP send completed

Scenario: Bot submission with the hidden honeypot field filled is discarded
Steps: Fill the form and the hidden website field, Submit
Expected result: Bot sees a success message; nothing is stored or emailed
Actual result: Request returned in 24 ms with success; no lead stored

Scenario: Invalid email is rejected and kept in the field
Steps: Enter not-an-email, Subscribe
Expected result: "Please enter a valid email address.", value kept

Scenario: Signing up twice with the same email creates one subscriber
Steps: Subscribe with the same email twice
Expected result: Both show "Thanks for subscribing." (no enumeration); exactly one active subscriber
Actual result: Same message both times, field cleared, one active subscriber (see NEWS case in pipelines)

Scenario: Every workspace is reachable from the sidebar and command palette
Steps: Expand each module group; open the command palette and scroll the list
Expected result: SEO Center, Newsletter Hub, CRM Pipeline, Hiring Pipeline, Media Studio, Insights Dashboard, Activity Timeline and AI Workspace all listed; active item highlighted with correct breadcrumb
Actual result: Initially only AI Workspace was linked; the other 7 were only reachable by typing the URL (DEF-007). After the fix all 8 are listed, highlighted, and breadcrumbed (e.g. Media > Media Studio)
